orders.thesis: Steady uptrend, low volatility, holding through likely earnings. No evidence to change the view; the stock is near the top of its range with no edge from price data alone. Keep the position modest and let the stop protect it.

summary: First session. AAPL horizon expired, so I extended it 10 trading days (stop 6%, target 9%). Position is 31.5% with 68.5% cash. The movers list had FFIV -20.7% (364), LSTR -17.6%, GMAB +29%, but I have no news access and found no price-based edge, so I made no new trades. Next session: check whether AAPL earnings have occurred and how the price reacted. Consider post-earnings drift candidates (FFIV, LSTR) only if history shows stabilisation. Write general notes once a lesson is learned.
